desc:
Client Communication Specialist https://remote.com/jobs/new-york-house-of-engineers-nyhe-c1p0jk3d/remote-client-communication-specialist-j11jqu9h

We are seeking a proactive and professional Remote Client Communication Specialist to manage and support client interactions across various communication channels. In this role, you will ensure that client inquiries are handled promptly, information is communicated clearly, and internal teams remain informed about client needs and requests. The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, and able to maintain strong professional relationships with clients.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as a primary point of contact for client communications via email, phone, and online platforms
Respond to inquiries and provide accurate information about company services and project updates
Coordinate communication between clients and internal departments
Maintain detailed records of client interactions and communications
Assist with scheduling meetings, calls, and follow-ups with clients and project teams
Monitor communication channels and ensure timely responses to client requests
Escalate complex issues or concerns to appropriate departments or management
Support administrative tasks related to client relations and project coordination
assessment: Expect an assessment that includes typing, multi-tasking, internet speed, and personality
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
